do_not_mark: a third-party service the product connects to, like "SSO via Okta"

examples.text: Please move the Apple account from monthly to annual billing. Current charge is $75 per seat.

MONEY.description: A monetary amount, including the currency symbol.
do_not_mark: seat counts and other quantities, like "400+ records"

examples.text: CSV export shows a past-due balance of $99 even though the payment cleared on May 22.

do_not_mark: times of day without a date, like "this morning"

examples.text: Can we get a refund for the duplicate $49 charge on last Tuesday? It appears twice in CSV export.
